feature: one source-bound inner boundary component on a static planar ring; geometric aperture, not inferred damage
view_domain: XY orthographic, opaque factory Workbench; other views and arbitrary materials not certified in this first reference
oracle: 12 literal inner-edge quarter/midpoint samples; analytic foreground-rectangle inclusion independent of production rays; six fixed scenarios

quality.blue_control: outside sample alpha>128, B>R+40 and B>G+20; inside sample not blue, RGB L1 difference>=80
quality.pixel_scope: controlled blue opaque planar fixture only, not general segmentation or model readability
quality.reference_want_detail: known useful feature visibility >=8/12, overview width<16px, reference width>=16px and zoom>=2
quality.no_benefit: problem occluded, fully occluded, overview already readable, source incomplete or precision uncertain => no adopted extra image
quality.unknown: keep source/visibility/pixel failures in full case denominator; never count unknown as normal or drop failed scenarios

future_candidate_budgets.budget_change: new independent patch capability only; existing V3 4096 tests remains unchanged

reference_experiment.source_cases: 39 frozen raw fixtures, once with one target and once with a real reference mesh; additional transform/occluder domain probes
reference_experiment.old_path: existing actual paired native observation and consumer, up to overview plus detail
reference_experiment.reference_path: separate oracle-placed local render, not a new automatic engine feature; negative scenes rendered for falsification only
reference_experiment.cost_scope: host capture plus native old observation plus consumer, versus capture plus reference render plus sanitation; raw diagnosis/transport/patch planning remain separately unmeasured
reference_experiment.candidate_cost_rule_after_reference: per-case empirical reference p95 + max(20ms, 0.5*reference p95); initial low-sample budget only, independent confirmation required
reference_experiment.no_claim: not an installed Codex task, current Hook test, candidate improvement or formal model trial
